    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">QT自定义控件之内嵌报表（三）</span>
    

</a>

        </h2>
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>一、作品展示</p>
<p>先来看下视频的整体效果，通过C++/QT,同时借助QPainter画出来</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1837289/202608/1837289-20260801205110388-355610320.gif" alt="PixPin_2026-08-01_20-19-21" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>二、整个创作过程</p>
<p>1、背景图</p>
<p>首先我们还是得把背景图设计好，借助小助理们的各种更改，得到下面的图片，这张图也得需要花点心思调理调理</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1837289/202608/1837289-20260801205749053-1132147662.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>2、弯路过程</p>
<p>每次发作品的时候，总会有网友提醒我，现在<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="AI" data-pretit="ai">AI这么强大了，谁还自己手搓控件啊，也是。所以我也借助国内的几大模型尝试下，它们给了我画出来。通过纯源码，编译执行之后，它们给了我一张下面的图：</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1837289/202608/1837289-20260801205325030-633225263.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;这么看起来，还是有点意思的，没准加上背景图片，还是能很快实现，于是我继续训练它们，并把背景图片的接口给放开试试，于是我得到了下面的图片：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1837289/202608/1837289-20260801205408059-132288790.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>发现这个跟我的背景的契合度还是相差有点多啊，也许我还需要花时间去多跟它们沟通沟通，不过最后我还是想了想，还是自己手搓吧。</p>
<p>3、手搓实现</p>
<p>自己手搓版的关键点也同样是，需要将数据放置到指定的位置点，这可是有点小考验，毕竟咱们还是要吃饭的，说干就干。将部分代码展示下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:cpp;gutter:true;">void MainWindow::SlotTimer()
{
    int randomNum = QRandomGenerator::global()-&gt;bounded(101);

    QString num = QString("TB_%1").arg(QString::number(randomNum,10));

    QString type = QString("试验_%1").arg(QString::number(randomNum,10));

    QString id_Num =  QString("编号_%1").arg(QString::number(randomNum,10));

    QString resportName =  QString("报告_%1").arg(QString::number(randomNum,10));

    QString type_Num = QString("型号_%1").arg(QString::number(randomNum,10));

    QString voltage‌ = QString("%1").arg(QString::number(randomNum,10));

    QString vol = QString("%1").arg(volume‌[QRandomGenerator::global()-&gt;bounded(4)]);

    QString res = QString("%1").arg(result[QRandomGenerator::global()-&gt;bounded(3)]);

    QString company = QString("单位_%1").arg(QString::number(randomNum,10));

    QString person = QString("试验员_%1").arg(QString::number(randomNum,10));

    QString gra = QString("%1").arg(grade[QRandomGenerator::global()-&gt;bounded(3)]);

    ui-&gt;widget-&gt;Set_TextChangeEvent(0,num);

    ui-&gt;widget-&gt;Set_TextChangeEvent(1,type);

    ui-&gt;widget-&gt;Set_TextChangeEvent(2,id_Num);

    ui-&gt;widget-&gt;Set_TextChangeEvent(3,resportName);

    ui-&gt;widget-&gt;Set_TextChangeEvent(4,type_Num);

    ui-&gt;widget-&gt;Set_TextChangeEvent(5,res);

    ui-&gt;widget-&gt;Set_TextChangeEvent(6,company);

    ui-&gt;widget-&gt;Set_TextChangeEvent(7,person);

    ui-&gt;widget-&gt;Set_TextChangeEvent(19,vol);

    ui-&gt;widget-&gt;Set_TextChangeEvent(20,QString::number(randomNum+5,10));

    ui-&gt;widget-&gt;Set_TextChangeEvent(21,gra);

    ui-&gt;widget-&gt;Set_TextChangeEvent(22,gra);

    double randouble = randomNum/100.00;

    for(int i = 8 ; i &lt; 19; i++)
    {
        if((i == 8)||(i == 9))
        {
            ui-&gt;widget-&gt;Set_TextChangeEvent(i, QString::number(randomNum*i,10));
        }
        else if(i == 11)
        {
            ui-&gt;widget-&gt;Set_TextChangeEvent(11, res);
        }
        else
        {
             ui-&gt;widget-&gt;Set_TextChangeEvent(i, QString::number(randouble*i,'f',2));
        }

    }

}
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1837289/202608/1837289-20260801205522204-406980487.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>这次新增了字体颜色的区分，然后依然在研究如何将图表等自由的放入，继续研究中。。。</p>
